problem.quota: Storage is full, so your progress isn't being saved. Back it up in Settings.
problem.unavailable: This browser blocks saving. Your progress will be lost when you close the game. Back it up in Settings.
problem.writeFailed: Your progress couldn't be saved. Back it up in Settings.
problem.recovered: Your last save was damaged, so an earlier copy was loaded.
problem.unreadable: Save could not be read. Import a backup?
problem.tooNew: Your save is from a newer version of Ageborn. Reload the page to update. Nothing is saved until then.

import.notACode: That isn't an Ageborn save code.
import.corrupt: That code is damaged. Copy the whole code and try again.
import.notASave: That code doesn't contain a save.
import.tooNew: That save is from a newer version. Reload the game to update, then try again.
